thread:
ana: Heads-up: two incoming asks about per-route token limits and quota reporting look like duplicates. Tickets: #4321 and #4389. Propose we merge into single backlog item and add clarifying ACs before prioritizing. Thoughts?

mike: Yep, saw both. #4321 from Acme (enterprise/legal) wants per-route quotas + per-API usage breakdown. #4389 from Beta startup wants per-key throttles. Overlap = quota breakdown + per-route controls. Links: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/4321, https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/4389

kevin: From sales POV, Acme is a potential Dedicated customer. High willingness to pay for per-route limits. Beta is low ARR. Suggest we label `priority: medium - sales-influence` and tie to Dedicated roadmap.

sasha: Need to scope. Are we shipping UI + API + billing metrics? Also what's minimum viable AC? I propose: API to set route-level quota, dashboard metric per-route usage, and event logs for enforcement. No UI polish for v1.

ana: (typo fixed) ana: Agreed on minimal scope. Proposed labels: customer-request, duplicate-merged, dedicated-opportunity, scope: api+metrics, effort: M. Proposed owner: @sasha. If no objections, I'll create GH issue and merge tickets.

intake-bot: Automated note: merged tickets #4321 & #4389 into ticket #4444. Original requesters will be CC'd.

mike: Small ask: include 'notify requester with timeframe' in the issue. They asked for ETA.

ana: (typo fixed) ana: Draft message to requesters: 'Thanks — we're consolidating your requests under #4444. Targeting investigation in next sprint; will follow up with ETA after scoping. —Ana'

kevin: :thumbsup: include 'sales contact' in issue and tag 'priority:sales' so AE can follow.

sasha: I'll take ownership for scoping. ETA for spec in 5 business days. Filing acceptance criteria now.

sasha: Acceptance Criteria:
```
- API: POST /v1/routes/{route_id}/quota => sets daily token limit (return 200 on success)
- Dashboard: per-route tokens metric (last 30d), configurable window
- Alerts: email/webhook when route >= 90% of quota
- Enforcement: requests over quota return 429 and log event with route_id, client_id
- Tests: e2e enforcement + unit tests for quota calc + integration test for metric accuracy
```

ana: Perfect. I'll create GH issue #4444 with labels (customer-request, duplicate-merged, dedicated-opportunity, needs-prioritization) and link back to original tickets. We should mark as 'needs-prioritization' in backlog until PM org prioritizes.

mike: Noted. I'll ping requesters when issue created.

kevin: Thanks all — good to consolidate. We'll follow up on sales side once the spec is posted.
